First, to study how cyber threats and weaknesses in energy system have changed over time. Seven is to study different ways of protecting and recovering energy systems for cyber attacks. Third is to identify the main research trends and the current problem more gaps in this area. And fourth one is to identify future research areas that can make energy system more secure and more resilient. For this review, a Christmas-based process was used to organize the literature review. Because of these changes, research is moving from simply protected system to making the whole energy system more resilient. There are several major cyber threats to energy system. First is false data ingestion, where I tap us, change data measurement to make the system make the front decision. The front is tension via malware, which can stop system from working properly. The system needs to quickly identify unusual activities so attacks that don't need mitigation. Once an attack is found, its impact need to be reduced. Both this adaptation. Security systems also need to become more flexible when it has changed and IT recovery and OT recovery are not always properly connected.
